title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — Mammograms (pseudonymised)
description: Minimally processed pseudonymised metadata (TCode instead of StudyID, shifted dates, PII removed, letter codes as numbers) from mammograms.json containing Whether the participant has had a mammogram, how many and when, details of the most recent one, and any abnormal result, collected at baseline.

R0_Mammogram.title: Whether the participant has ever had a mammogram
R0_Mammogram.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No.

default: S02:p.20 Q7:1 Have you ever had an X-ray of your breast (mammogram)? Yes No

R0_Mammogram_Number.title: Number of mammograms

default: S02:p.20 Q7:1 If yes, how many times have you been for a mammogram?

R0_Mammogram_Number.x-universe: Only completed when R0_Mammogram = 1 (Yes); 7:1 says 'If no, go to question 7:4'.

R0_Mammogram_Age1.title: Age at the first mammogram (years)

default: S02:p.20 Q7:1 At what age was the first mammogram? years

R0_Mammogram_Age1.x-universe: Only completed when R0_Mammogram = 1 (Yes); 7:1 says 'If no, go to question 7:4'.

R0_Mammogram_Details.title: Whether the most recent mammogram was for screening
R0_Mammogram_Details.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No.

default: S02:p.20 Q7:2 Please give details of the mammogram you had most recently: Was this for screening? Yes No

R0_Mammogram_Details.x-universe: Only completed when R0_Mammogram = 1 (Yes); 7:1 says 'If no, go to question 7:4'.

R0_Mammogram_Abnormal.title: Whether a mammogram result was abnormal
R0_Mammogram_Abnormal.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No.

default: S02:p.20 Q7:3 Have you had a mammogram where the result was abnormal? Yes No

R0_Mammogram_Abnormal.x-universe: Only completed when R0_Mammogram = 1 (Yes); 7:1 says 'If no, go to question 7:4'.

R0_Mammogram_AbnormalAge.title: Age at the abnormal mammogram (years)

default: S02:p.20 Q7:3 If yes, at what age? years

R0_Mammogram_AbnormalAge.x-universe: Only completed when R0_Mammogram_Abnormal = 1 (Yes); 7:3 says 'If yes, at what age?'.

R0_Mammogram_AbnormalDesc.title: Description of the abnormality

default: S02:p.20 Q7:3 Please describe the abnormality

R0_Mammogram_AbnormalDesc.x-universe: Only completed when a mammogram result was abnormal (R0_Mammogram_Abnormal = 1).

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R050: the participant did not answer Yes to ever having had a mammogram (0 or 2), so questions 7:1 (number and age), 7:2 and 7:3 are not asked -- the counts, ages, year and answers carry the missing-numeric sentinel and the places and description carry the missing-string sentinel. Questionnaire p.20 Q7:1: 'If no, go to question 7:4'.

default: S02:p.20 Q7:1 If 'no', go to question 7:4

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R051: the participant did not answer Yes to having had an abnormal mammogram (0 or 2), so the age and the description are structurally not applicable -- R0_Mammogram_AbnormalAge carries the missing-numeric sentinel and R0_Mammogram_AbnormalDesc the missing-string sentinel (R052). Questionnaire p.20 Q7:3: 'If yes, at what age?' and 'Please describe the abnormality'.

default: S02:p.20 Q7:3 If yes, at what age?
